neighbours.label: Words about a retrieved/acquired/rescued thing or creature: new home, new pet, souvenir, rescued, missing, returned, gift
fire: The kittens were rescued from a flooded barn and later found a loving new home with a nurse.
Every tourist wanted a small souvenir from the market before the ferry left the island.
Police searched the hills for a missing hiker who had not been seen since Tuesday.
Their new pet rabbit hid under the couch for most of the first week in the house.
The firefighters retrieved the old photographs from the burned house and returned them to the family.
She gave him a handmade scarf as a birthday gift before he left for college.
A group of sailors rescued the stranded swimmer and brought him back to the harbor safely.
The museum acquired a rare painting that had been missing since the war.
quiet: The kittens slept all afternoon in the barn while the rain kept falling on the roof.
Every tourist wanted to see the market before the ferry left the island at noon.
Police closed the road through the hills because the snow had started falling again.
Their rabbit hutch needed a fresh coat of paint after the long wet winter.
The firefighters trained at the station, then cleaned the trucks and checked the hoses.
She wrote him a long letter on his birthday before he left for college.
A group of sailors repaired the old boat and sailed it around the harbor slowly.
The museum opened a new wing with paintings from the eighteenth century.

notes: Label and sentences written by Claude Sonnet subagents (8 poles each) from the card text alone (prompt: haiku_labeler/prompt_l5.md); one retry on mechanical checks. Part of a 192-pole layer-5 sweep.
